title: Final Artifact Routing: final revision work stops becoming fake exams

claims.summary: The UX regression compiles the live failure shape and proves the final revision/prototype defense rows ship as assignment artifacts with no fake exam entries.
ZIP manifest readiness now merges self-grading P0/P1/P2 quality findings, so P0 quality blockers make PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json readiness blocked.
Focused regressions cover registry classification, compiler routing, and manifest quality-readiness agreement; fresh v0.15.146 provider evidence remains a follow-up.

knownRemainingTargets: A fresh deployed v0.15.146 ZIP/log audit must prove final revision/prototype defense rows no longer route into Quiz & Exam Bank in real provider output.
Texture still needs repeated-scaffold cleanup until fresh packages repeatedly reach 100/100 with no texture caveat.
Source rows must remain real, trusted, on-topic, license-safe, and concept-linked across UX and Project Management domains.
Chrome log capture after laptop restart/reconnect remains an automation reliability target.
